summary: Kept. The stored 'closed for the 2026 season for renovations' is NOT supported: only the DuPont Lodge closed, and the campground stayed open. It is now in its normal winter close, with RA bookable Apr 1 - Oct 31, 2027. Status set to open. 21 Standard Electric RV sites (30A, RV33 50A), mostly 18-24 ft; about 10 take a 23-ft rig (max 28 ft pull-through RV33). $35 Sun-Thu / $40 Fri-Sat / $45 holiday. Showers, flush toilets, laundry, grocery, dump. Season 04-01..10-31. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone -> the campground line.
